title: Inspirit
summary: INSPIR'IT, verb transitive [in and spirit.] To infuse or excite spirit in; to enliven; to animate; to give new lift to; to encourage; to invigorate. The courage of Agamemnon is inspirited by the love

inlines.v: INSPIR'IT, verb transitive [in and spirit.] To infuse or excite spirit in; to enliven; to animate; to give new lift to; to encourage; to invigorate. The courage of Agamemnon is inspirited by the love of empire and ambition.
